title: Persons and places
html:
09 Persons and places

In: 08_table/out/xiaozong_records.jsonl. Out (per run): mentions.csv, candidates.csv, dropped.csv, report.json, and a review page. Persons are linked to CBDB, places to TGAZ (CHGIS). Offices are not extracted, and no other authority is used (the author's ruling, 2026-11-13).

Status: full run done 2026-11-14, links not yet reviewed. The pilot (200 records) is kept in pilot/; the whole reign (13,552 records) is in full/. Numbers for the full run are in JOURNAL.md and full/out/report.json.

Who does what

part who file
choose the records, cut batches script sample.py
read each record, return the names as written Codex (codex exec, model gpt-6-astra, medium effort) extract.py, prompt.md, schema.json
check every string is in the record; look up; decide script link.py
judge a sample of the links the historian build_review.py

Codex runs in an empty folder, read-only, and never sees CBDB or TGAZ. Its answer, its event log and the checksum of the prompt are kept for every batch in <run>/raw/.

uv run sample.py pilot && uv run extract.py pilot --jobs 3 && uv run link.py pilot && uv run build_review.py pilot

Rules

The rules for the lookup, the date test, the evidence and each decision are written at the top of link.py. In short:

  • A string that is not in the record, character for character, is dropped and listed.
  • Person: every CBDB person with that name is a candidate. Out go those not alive in the record's year, and undated persons of another dynasty. A CBDB posting whose office name stands in the record is evidence; if its years cover the date, strong evidence.
  • Place: the name as written among places that exist in that year; a bare name (山西, 大同) is tried with 布政使司, 府, 州, 縣, 衛.
  • Every candidate, kept or excluded, is in candidates.csv with the reason. A mention that cannot be decided keeps all its candidates and gets no id.

Pilot numbers (2026-11-13)

200 records (38,783 characters), drawn evenly over the 19 years and three length classes, so long records are over-represented. 186 records name a person or a place.

Codex: 8 batches, 208,105 tokens in and 23,971 out, 525 seconds of model time (about 4 minutes with three at once).

What the numbers mean, before review

  • "Linked" is not "right". The review page (pilot/review/entities_review.html, 69 cards, up to 8 per method) is how the precision of each method will be known.
  • Names CBDB does not have are of four kinds: OCR misreadings (揚士奇, 齋世美), eunuchs and minor officers, foreigners (阿黑麻, 黎灝), and princes written without 朱 (a second lookup with 朱 is tried and marked weak).
  • Places TGAZ does not have are mostly frontier and military names (遼東, 宣府, 甘肅), foreign countries (朝鮮, 占城), regions (兩廣, 兩京), and OCR misreadings (遷東).
  • Recall (what Codex missed) is not measured yet.

The instructions to the model

You are reading records from the Ming Xiaozong shilu 明孝宗實錄 (1487-1505), in classical Chinese. The text is unproofread OCR, so some characters are wrong. Do not correct them.

For every record below, list the PERSONS and the PLACES named in it.

Rules 1. Copy each string exactly as it stands in the record, character for character. Never normalise, correct, complete or translate. If a string is not in the record, do not return it. 2. PERSONS. Return every person named by a personal name: 劉健, 王恕, 張鶴齡, 脫羅干. - text: the name as written at that place. Leave out the office or title before it (太子太保吏部尚書王恕 gives 王恕; 英國公張懋 gives 張懋). - full_name: the person's full name if the same record gives it (a later bare 恕 has full_name 王恕). If the record never gives more than text, repeat text. - kind: "name" for a personal name; "title" for a person referred to only by a title that points to one person (壽寧侯, 皇太后, 寧王, 朝鮮國王) when no personal name is given with it. Do not return 上 or 帝 for the emperor, and do not return bare offices (吏部尚書) or groups (文武羣臣, 六科十三道). - List each different string once per record. 3. PLACES. Return every geographic name: provinces, prefectures, counties, guards (衛), passes, rivers, mountains, cities, foreign countries: 山西, 大同, 應天府, 遼東, 朝鮮. - Return the name as written (大同, not 大同府, unless the record writes 大同府). - A place inside an office title counts (巡撫遼東都御史 gives 遼東; 山西按察司僉事 gives 山西; 南京禮部 gives 南京). - Do not return palace buildings, temples, tombs or government offices as places (奉天殿, 太廟, 長陵, 吏部 are not places). - List each different string once per record. 4. A record with no person or place gets empty lists. Return every record id you were given, in the same order.

Do not run commands or read files. Answer only with the JSON object.

Code

sample.py 78 lines
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# ///
"""Step 09a. Choose the records to read, and cut them into batches.

  uv run sample.py pilot        200 records spread over the reign and over record lengths
  uv run sample.py full         every record

In:  08_table/out/xiaozong_records.jsonl
Out: <run>/batches/bNNN.json    {"batch": "bNNN", "records": [{"id", "text"}]}
     <run>/sample.csv           which records, and why (year, length class)

Pilot sample: records are grouped by lunar year (19 groups) and by length (short up to 40
characters, middle 41-200, long over 200). The same number is drawn from each of the three
length classes in every year, with a fixed seed, so the run can be repeated.
A batch holds at most 25 records and at most 6,000 characters; a longer record is a batch
of its own.
"""
import csv, json, pathlib, random, sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
TABLE = HERE.parent / "08_table/out/xiaozong_records.jsonl"
SEED, PILOT_N, MAX_REC, MAX_CHARS = 20261113, 200, 25, 6000


def length_class(n):
    return "short" if n <= 40 else "middle" if n <= 200 else "long"


def main(run):
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in TABLE.open(encoding="utf-8")]
    rows = [r for r in rows if r["text"].strip()]
    if run == "pilot":
        rng = random.Random(SEED)
        groups = {}
        for r in rows:
            groups.setdefault((r["era"], r["year"], length_class(len(r["text"]))), []).append(r)
        keys = sorted(groups, key=lambda k: (k[0] != "成化", int(k[1] or 0), k[2]))
        picked, round_ = [], 0
        while len(picked) < PILOT_N:
            for k in keys:
                g = groups[k]
                if round_ < len(g) and len(picked) < PILOT_N:
                    if round_ == 0:
                        rng.shuffle(g)
                    picked.append(g[round_])
            round_ += 1
        order = {r["id"]: i for i, r in enumerate(rows)}
        rows = sorted(picked, key=lambda r: order[r["id"]])
    out = HERE / run
    (out / "batches").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for old in (out / "batches").glob("b*.json"):
        old.unlink()
    batches, cur, size = [], [], 0
    for r in rows:
        n = len(r["text"])
        if cur and (len(cur) >= MAX_REC or size + n > MAX_CHARS):
            batches.append(cur); cur, size = [], 0
        cur.append(r); size += n
    if cur:
        batches.append(cur)
    with (out / "sample.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(["batch", "id", "era", "year", "month", "gregorian", "chars", "length_class"])
        for i, b in enumerate(batches, 1):
            name = f"b{i:03d}"
            (out / "batches" / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(
                {"batch": name, "records": [{"id": r["id"], "text": r["text"]} for r in b]},
                ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
            for r in b:
                w.writerow([name, r["id"], r["era"], r["year"], r["month"], r["gregorian"],
                            len(r["text"]), length_class(len(r["text"]))])
    print(f"{run}: {len(rows)} records, {sum(len(r['text']) for r in rows):,} characters, {len(batches)} batches")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "pilot")
extract.py 60 lines
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# ///
"""Step 09b. Codex reads each batch and returns the persons and places it names.

  uv run extract.py pilot [--jobs 3] [--model MODEL]

In:  <run>/batches/bNNN.json, prompt.md, schema.json
Out: <run>/raw/bNNN.json        Codex's answer, exactly as returned
     <run>/raw/bNNN.events.jsonl  Codex's event log (model, token use)
     <run>/raw/bNNN.meta.json   command, seconds, exit code, sha256 of the prompt
A batch that already has an answer is skipped, so the run can be stopped and started again.
Codex runs in an empty folder, read-only, and is told not to run commands. It never sees
CBDB or TGAZ: linking is done afterwards by link.py.
"""
import argparse, concurrent.futures as cf, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, time

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent


def run_batch(path, raw, model):
    name = path.stem
    out = raw / f"{name}.json"
    if out.exists() and out.stat().st_size > 2:
        return name, "skipped", 0
    batch = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    prompt = (HERE / "prompt.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for r in batch["records"]:
        prompt += f"\n[{r['id']}]\n{r['text']}\n"
    cmd = ["codex", "exec", "--skip-git-repo-check", "--ephemeral", "-s", "read-only", "--json",
           "--output-schema", str(HERE / "schema.json"), "-o", str(out)]
    if model:
        cmd += ["-m", model]
    t = time.time()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as empty:
        p = subprocess.run(cmd + ["-C", empty, "-"], input=prompt, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=1800)
    secs = round(time.time() - t, 1)
    (raw / f"{name}.events.jsonl").write_text(p.stdout, encoding="utf-8")
    (raw / f"{name}.meta.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "batch": name, "command": cmd, "seconds": secs, "exit_code": p.returncode,
        "records": len(batch["records"]), "prompt_chars": len(prompt),
        "prompt_sha256": hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "stderr_tail": p.stderr[-800:]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    ok = p.returncode == 0 and out.exists() and out.stat().st_size > 2
    return name, "ok" if ok else f"FAILED ({p.returncode})", secs


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("run"); ap.add_argument("--jobs", type=int, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=""); ap.add_argument("--only", default="")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    raw = HERE / a.run / "raw"; raw.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    paths = sorted((HERE / a.run / "batches").glob("b*.json"))
    if a.only:
        paths = [p for p in paths if p.stem in a.only.split(",")]
    with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(a.jobs) as ex:
        for name, status, secs in ex.map(lambda p: run_batch(p, raw, a.model), paths):
            print(name, status, secs, flush=True)
link.py 353 lines
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# ///
"""Step 09c. Check Codex's strings against the text, then link them to CBDB and TGAZ.

  uv run link.py pilot

In:   <run>/batches/*.json, <run>/raw/*.json   the records and Codex's answers
      08_table/out/xiaozong_records.jsonl       the date of each record
      CBDB and TGAZ (local SQLite files, read only)
Out:  <run>/out/mentions.csv     one row per string per record, with the decision
      <run>/out/candidates.csv   EVERY candidate looked at, kept or excluded, with the reason
      <run>/out/dropped.csv      strings Codex returned that are not in the record
      <run>/out/report.json

Nothing is thrown away: a string that fails a test stays in a file with the reason.

PERSONS (CBDB)
  lookup   full_name against BIOG_MAIN.c_name_chn and ALTNAME_DATA.c_alt_name_chn.
           kind=title, one-character names and women written as surname + 氏 are
           recorded but not looked up.
  dates    a candidate "fits" when the record's year lies in the person's life:
           birth (or index year) + 15 .. death + 2, or birth + 95 when no death year;
           or, with no life dates, within 10 years of the person's dated postings or
           floruit years. "undated" = CBDB gives no year at all.
           Excluded: dates that do not fit; undated persons of another dynasty.
  evidence a CBDB posting whose office name (2+ characters) stands in the record: 3 points;
           and 4 more when the posting's years cover the record's year (3 years slack).
           Offices are used only as evidence. They are not extracted or linked.
  decision office-in-text-dated  one best candidate, posting covers the date     (strong)
           office-in-text        one best candidate, office named, date not shown (medium)
           unique-fits-date      one candidate left, and its dates fit            (strong)
           unique-undated        one candidate left, CBDB gives it no dates       (weak)
           only-dated-candidate  several left, exactly one has fitting dates      (weak)
           ambiguous             several left, nothing decides: no id, all kept
           no-candidate-fits     CBDB has the name, but nobody alive then
           not-in-cbdb           CBDB does not have the name
           ...+朱                a two-character name CBDB does not have was looked up again
                                 with the imperial surname 朱 (princes are written without it).
                                 Always weak.

PLACES (TGAZ / CHGIS)
  lookup   the string as written, among places that exist in the record's year;
           if none, the string plus 布政使司, 府, 州, 縣, 衛 (a bare 山西 or 大同).
  decision unique                one place
           same-place-duplicate  several records of one place (same name and kind, or within
                                 0.1 degree): the narrowest date window is taken
           highest-level         a bare name fits several levels (大同府, 大同縣): the highest
                                 is taken. A convention, not evidence.                (weak)
           ambiguous             different places, nothing decides
           not-in-tgaz           no place of that name in that year
"""
import collections, csv, json, pathlib, sqlite3, sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent))
from lib import manifest  # noqa: E402

CBDB = pathlib.Path("cbdb.db")
TGAZ = pathlib.Path("tgaz.db")
TABLE = HERE.parent / "08_table/out/xiaozong_records.jsonl"
MING = 19
SUFFIXES = ["布政使司", "府", "州", "縣", "衛"]
LEVEL = {"布政司": 0, "京師": 1, "府": 2, "直隶州": 3, "州": 4, "县": 5, "卫": 6}


class Cbdb:
    def __init__(self):
        self.con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{CBDB}?mode=ro", uri=True)
        self.alt = dict(self.con.execute("SELECT c_name_type_code, c_name_type_desc_chn FROM ALTNAME_CODES"))
        self.dyn = dict(self.con.execute("SELECT c_dy, c_dynasty_chn FROM DYNASTIES"))
        self.cache, self.posts = {}, {}

    def candidates(self, name):
        if name not in self.cache:
            found = {}
            q = ("SELECT c_personid, c_name_chn, c_index_year, c_birthyear, c_deathyear, "
                 "c_fl_earliest_year, c_fl_latest_year, c_dy FROM BIOG_MAIN WHERE c_personid=?")
            for (pid,) in self.con.execute("SELECT c_personid FROM BIOG_MAIN WHERE c_name_chn=?", (name,)):
                found[pid] = "main name"
            for pid, code in self.con.execute(
                    "SELECT c_personid, c_alt_name_type_code FROM ALTNAME_DATA WHERE c_alt_name_chn=?", (name,)):
                found.setdefault(pid, f"alt name: {self.alt.get(code, code)}")
            out = []
            for pid, how in found.items():
                row = self.con.execute(q, (pid,)).fetchone()
                if row and pid > 0:
                    out.append(dict(zip(["id", "name", "index_year", "birth", "death", "fl_e", "fl_l", "dy"], row),
                                    matched_by=how))
            self.cache[name] = out
        return self.cache[name]

    def postings(self, pid):
        if pid not in self.posts:
            self.posts[pid] = self.con.execute(
                "SELECT o.c_office_chn, p.c_firstyear, p.c_lastyear FROM POSTED_TO_OFFICE_DATA p "
                "JOIN OFFICE_CODES o USING(c_office_id) WHERE p.c_personid=?", (pid,)).fetchall()
        return self.posts[pid]


def person_dates(c, posts, year):
    """-> ('fits' | 'does not fit' | 'undated', window as text)"""
    born = c["birth"] or c["index_year"] or None
    death = c["death"] or None
    if born or death:
        lo = born + 15 if born else death - 80
        hi = death + 2 if death else born + 95
        return ("fits" if lo <= year <= hi else "does not fit"), f"life {born or '?'}-{death or '?'}"
    ys = [y for _, a, b in posts for y in (a, b) if y] + [y for y in (c["fl_e"], c["fl_l"]) if y]
    if ys:
        return ("fits" if min(ys) - 10 <= year <= max(ys) + 10 else "does not fit"), f"active {min(ys)}-{max(ys)}"
    return "undated", ""


def link_person(cb, name, year, text):
    """-> decision dict, candidate rows"""
    cands = cb.candidates(name)
    rows, kept = [], []
    for c in cands:
        posts = cb.postings(c["id"])
        status, window = person_dates(c, posts, year)
        score, dated, ev = 0, False, []
        for office, fy, ly in posts:
            if office and len(office) >= 2 and office in text:
                score += 3
                cover = bool(fy or ly) and (fy or ly) - 3 <= year <= (ly or fy) + 3
                if cover:
                    score += 4; dated = True
                ev.append(f"{office} {fy or ''}-{ly or ''}{' covers the date' if cover else ''}")
        if status == "does not fit":
            verdict, why = "excluded", "dates do not fit"
        elif status == "undated" and c["dy"] != MING:
            verdict, why = "excluded", f"no dates, dynasty {cb.dyn.get(c['dy'], c['dy'])}"
        else:
            verdict, why = "kept", status
            kept.append((c, status, score, dated))
        rows.append({"candidate_id": c["id"], "candidate_name": c["name"], "matched_by": c["matched_by"],
                     "dates": window, "dynasty": cb.dyn.get(c["dy"], c["dy"]), "status": verdict, "reason": why,
                     "score": score, "evidence": "; ".join(sorted(set(ev)))})
    d = {"n_candidates": len(cands), "n_kept": len(kept), "linked_id": "", "linked_name": "", "confidence": ""}
    if not cands:
        d["method"] = "not-in-cbdb"
    elif not kept:
        d["method"] = "no-candidate-fits"
    else:
        best = max(k[2] for k in kept)
        top = [k for k in kept if k[2] == best]
        fits = [k for k in kept if k[1] == "fits"]
        pick = None
        if best > 0 and len(top) == 1:
            pick = top[0]
            d["method"], d["confidence"] = (("office-in-text-dated", "strong") if pick[3] else ("office-in-text", "medium"))
        elif len(kept) == 1:
            pick = kept[0]
            d["method"], d["confidence"] = (("unique-fits-date", "strong") if pick[1] == "fits" else ("unique-undated", "weak"))
        elif len(fits) == 1:
            pick = fits[0]
            d["method"], d["confidence"] = "only-dated-candidate", "weak"
        else:
            d["method"] = "ambiguous"
        if pick:
            d["linked_id"], d["linked_name"] = pick[0]["id"], pick[0]["name"]
            for r in rows:
                if r["candidate_id"] == pick[0]["id"]:
                    r["status"] = "chosen"
    return d, rows


class Tgaz:
    def __init__(self):
        self.con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{TGAZ}?mode=ro", uri=True)
        self.cache = {}

    def find(self, form, year):
        k = (form, year)
        if k not in self.cache:
            rows = self.con.execute(
                "SELECT DISTINCT p.sys_id, s.written_form, p.beg_yr, p.end_yr, f.name_vn, p.x_coord, p.y_coord, p.data_src "
                "FROM spelling s JOIN placename p ON p.id=s.placename_id JOIN ftype f ON f.id=p.ftype_id "
                "WHERE s.written_form=? AND p.beg_yr<=? AND p.end_yr>=?", (form, year, year)).fetchall()
            self.cache[k] = [dict(zip(["id", "name", "beg", "end", "kind", "x", "y", "src"], r)) for r in rows]
        return self.cache[k]


def same_place(a, b):
    if a["name"] == b["name"] and a["kind"] == b["kind"]:
        return True
    try:
        return abs(float(a["x"]) - float(b["x"])) < 0.1 and abs(float(a["y"]) - float(b["y"])) < 0.1 and a["name"] == b["name"]
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False


def link_place(tg, text, year):
    cands, how = tg.find(text, year), "as written"
    if not cands:
        cands = [dict(c, suffix=s) for s in SUFFIXES for c in tg.find(text + s, year)]
        how = "suffix added"
    rows = [{"candidate_id": c["id"], "candidate_name": c["name"], "matched_by": how,
             "dates": f"{c['beg']}-{c['end']}", "dynasty": c["kind"], "status": "kept", "reason": "exists in that year",
             "score": "", "evidence": f"{c['x']},{c['y']} {c['src']}"} for c in cands]
    d = {"n_candidates": len(cands), "n_kept": len(cands), "linked_id": "", "linked_name": "", "confidence": ""}
    if not cands:
        d["method"] = "not-in-tgaz"
        return d, rows
    narrow = lambda c: (c["end"] - c["beg"], c["id"])
    if len({c["id"] for c in cands}) == 1:
        pick, d["method"], d["confidence"] = cands[0], "unique", "strong"
    elif all(same_place(cands[0], c) for c in cands[1:]):
        pick, d["method"], d["confidence"] = min(cands, key=narrow), "same-place-duplicate", "strong"
    elif how == "suffix added":
        top = min(LEVEL.get(c["kind"], 9) for c in cands)
        best = [c for c in cands if LEVEL.get(c["kind"], 9) == top]
        if all(same_place(best[0], c) for c in best[1:]):
            pick, d["method"], d["confidence"] = min(best, key=narrow), "highest-level", "weak"
        else:
            pick, d["method"] = None, "ambiguous"
    else:
        pick, d["method"] = None, "ambiguous"
    if pick:
        d["linked_id"], d["linked_name"] = pick["id"], pick["name"]
        for r in rows:
            if r["candidate_id"] == pick["id"]:
                r["status"] = "chosen"
    if how == "suffix added" and d["confidence"] == "strong":
        d["confidence"] = "medium"
    return d, rows


def main(run):
    base = HERE / run
    out = base / "out"; out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    table = {}
    for l in TABLE.open(encoding="utf-8"):
        r = json.loads(l); table[r["id"]] = r
    cb, tg = Cbdb(), Tgaz()
    mentions, cand_rows, dropped, stat = [], [], [], collections.Counter()
    missing = []
    batch_files = sorted((base / "batches").glob("b*.json"))
    raw_files = []
    for bf in batch_files:
        rf = base / "raw" / bf.name
        texts = {r["id"]: r["text"] for r in json.loads(bf.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["records"]}
        if not rf.exists():
            missing += list(texts); continue
        raw_files.append(rf)
        answers = {r["id"]: r for r in json.loads(rf.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["records"]}
        for rid, text in texts.items():
            a = answers.get(rid)
            if a is None:
                missing.append(rid); continue
            rec = table[rid]
            year = int(rec["gregorian"][:4]) if rec.get("gregorian") else None
            seen = set()
            items = [("person", p["text"], p["full_name"], p["kind"]) for p in a["persons"]] + \
                    [("place", p["text"], p["text"], "") for p in a["places"]]
            for typ, s, full, kind in items:
                if (typ, s) in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add((typ, s))
                stat[f"{typ}_returned"] += 1
                if not s or s not in text:
                    dropped.append({"record_id": rid, "type": typ, "text": s, "full_name": full, "why": "not in the record"})
                    stat[f"{typ}_not_in_text"] += 1
                    continue
                m = {"record_id": rid, "gregorian": rec.get("gregorian", ""), "type": typ, "text": s,
                     "full_name": full, "kind": kind, "position": text.find(s), "note": ""}
                if typ == "person":
                    if kind == "title":
                        d, rows = {"n_candidates": 0, "n_kept": 0, "linked_id": "", "linked_name": "",
                                   "confidence": "", "method": "title-only"}, []
                    else:
                        key = full if full and full in text else s
                        if full and full not in text:
                            m["note"] = "full_name is not in the record; looked up as written"
                        if key.endswith("氏"):
                            d, rows = {"n_candidates": 0, "n_kept": 0, "linked_id": "", "linked_name": "",
                                       "confidence": "", "method": "surname-only"}, []
                        elif len(key) < 2:
                            d, rows = {"n_candidates": 0, "n_kept": 0, "linked_id": "", "linked_name": "",
                                       "confidence": "", "method": "one-character-name"}, []
                        elif year is None:
                            d, rows = {"n_candidates": 0, "n_kept": 0, "linked_id": "", "linked_name": "",
                                       "confidence": "", "method": "record-undated"}, []
                        else:
                            d, rows = link_person(cb, key, year, text)
                            if d["method"] == "not-in-cbdb" and len(key) == 2:
                                # members of the imperial clan are written without the surname 朱
                                d2, rows2 = link_person(cb, "朱" + key, year, text)
                                if d2["n_candidates"]:
                                    d, rows = d2, [dict(r, matched_by=r["matched_by"] + ", 朱 added") for r in rows2]
                                    d["method"] += "+朱"
                                    if d["confidence"]:
                                        d["confidence"] = "weak"
                                    m["note"] = "looked up as 朱" + key
                else:
                    d, rows = link_place(tg, s, year or 1496)
                m.update(d)
                mentions.append(m)
                m["_rows"] = [{"record_id": rid, "type": typ, "text": s, **r} for r in rows]
                m["_key"] = (key if typ == "person" and kind != "title" else s)
                cand_rows.extend(m["_rows"])

    # Second pass, persons only. A name left ambiguous takes the candidate that office evidence chose
    # for the same name in other records of this reign, when that candidate is among those kept here
    # and no other kept candidate was ever chosen that way. Marked weak; the vote count is recorded.
    MIN_VOTES = 3
    votes = collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
    for m in mentions:
        if m["type"] == "person" and m["method"].startswith("office-in-text") and m["linked_id"] != "":
            votes[m["_key"]][str(m["linked_id"])] += 1
    for m in mentions:
        if m["type"] != "person" or m["method"] != "ambiguous":
            continue
        kept = [r for r in m["_rows"] if r["status"] == "kept"]
        v = {str(r["candidate_id"]): votes[m["_key"]].get(str(r["candidate_id"]), 0) for r in kept}
        won = [c for c, n in v.items() if n > 0]
        if len(won) == 1 and v[won[0]] >= MIN_VOTES:
            r = next(r for r in kept if str(r["candidate_id"]) == won[0])
            r["status"] = "chosen"
            r["evidence"] = (r["evidence"] + "; " if r["evidence"] else "") + \
                f"office evidence chose this person for the same name in {v[won[0]]} other records of the reign"
            m.update(method="office-elsewhere", confidence="weak", linked_id=r["candidate_id"], linked_name=r["candidate_name"])
    for m in mentions:
        stat[f"{m['type']}|{m['method']}"] += 1

    def dump(name, rows, fields):
        with (out / name).open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
            w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields, extrasaction="ignore"); w.writeheader(); w.writerows(rows)
        return out / name

    files = [
        dump("mentions.csv", mentions, ["record_id", "gregorian", "type", "text", "full_name", "kind", "position",
                                        "n_candidates", "n_kept", "method", "confidence", "linked_id", "linked_name", "note"]),
        dump("candidates.csv", cand_rows, ["record_id", "type", "text", "candidate_id", "candidate_name", "matched_by",
                                           "dates", "dynasty", "status", "reason", "score", "evidence"]),
        dump("dropped.csv", dropped, ["record_id", "type", "text", "full_name", "why"]),
    ]
    rep = {"run": run, "batches": len(batch_files), "batches_answered": len(raw_files),
           "records_without_answer": missing, "records": sum(1 for _ in {m['record_id'] for m in mentions}),
           "counts": dict(sorted(stat.items()))}
    for typ in ("person", "place"):
        ms = [m for m in mentions if m["type"] == typ]
        rep[typ] = {"mentions": len(ms), "linked": sum(1 for m in ms if m["linked_id"] != ""),
                    "by_confidence": dict(collections.Counter(m["confidence"] or "none" for m in ms))}
    (out / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(rep, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    manifest.write(base, [TABLE] + batch_files + raw_files, files + [out / "report.json"], rep["counts"])
    print(json.dumps(rep, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# ///
"""Step 09d. A review page for a sample of the links: is this the right person / place?

  uv run build_review.py pilot

Up to 8 links are drawn for each method (fixed seed), one card each. Nothing is preselected.
The card shows the record with the string marked, and what CBDB or TGAZ says about the
entity that was chosen. Out: <run>/review/entities_review.html, items.json
"""
import csv, html, json, pathlib, random, sqlite3, sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("human-eval-review")))
from scripts.review_builder import ReviewBuilder  # noqa: E402

CBDB = "cbdb.db"
TGAZ = "tgaz.db"
PER_METHOD, SEED = 8, 20261113


def main(run):
    base = HERE / run
    ms = list(csv.DictReader((base / "out/mentions.csv").open(encoding="utf-8-sig")))
    texts = {}
    for bf in (base / "batches").glob("b*.json"):
        for r in json.loads(bf.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["records"]:
            texts[r["id"]] = r["text"]
    cb = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{CBDB}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    tg = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{TGAZ}?mode=ro", uri=True)
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    groups = {}
    for m in ms:
        if m["linked_id"]:
            groups.setdefault((m["type"], m["method"]), []).append(m)
    rb = ReviewBuilder(title="明孝宗實錄: persons and places, pilot links",
                       subtitle="Is the linked CBDB person or TGAZ place the one the record means?",
                       lang="zh-Hant", cjk=True, result_filename=f"entities_review_results_{run}.json",
                       storage_key=f"xiaozong-entities-{run}-{SEED}")
    items = []
    for (typ, method), g in sorted(groups.items()):
        seen, pick = set(), []
        for m in rng.sample(g, len(g)):
            if (m["full_name"], m["linked_id"]) not in seen and len(pick) < PER_METHOD:
                seen.add((m["full_name"], m["linked_id"])); pick.append(m)
        for m in pick:
            text, pos = texts[m["record_id"]], int(m["position"])
            a, b = max(0, pos - 90), min(len(text), pos + len(m["text"]) + 90)
            src = (("…" if a else "") + html.escape(text[a:pos]) + "<mark>" + html.escape(m["text"]) + "</mark>"
                   + html.escape(text[pos + len(m["text"]):b]) + ("…" if b < len(text) else ""))
            if typ == "person":
                r = cb.execute("SELECT c_name_chn, c_birthyear, c_deathyear, c_index_year FROM BIOG_MAIN WHERE c_personid=?",
                               (m["linked_id"],)).fetchone()
                posts = cb.execute("SELECT DISTINCT o.c_office_chn, p.c_firstyear, p.c_lastyear FROM POSTED_TO_OFFICE_DATA p "
                                   "JOIN OFFICE_CODES o USING(c_office_id) WHERE p.c_personid=? ORDER BY p.c_firstyear LIMIT 8",
                                   (m["linked_id"],)).fetchall()
                info = (f"CBDB {m['linked_id']}: {r[0]}, born {r[1] or '?'}, died {r[2] or '?'}, index year {r[3] or '?'}. "
                        "Postings: " + ("; ".join(f"{o} {fy or ''}-{ly or ''}" for o, fy, ly in posts) or "none recorded"))
            else:
                r = tg.execute("SELECT s.written_form, f.name_vn, p.beg_yr, p.end_yr, p.x_coord, p.y_coord FROM placename p "
                               "JOIN spelling s ON s.placename_id=p.id JOIN ftype f ON f.id=p.ftype_id "
                               "WHERE p.sys_id=? AND s.script_id=1 LIMIT 1", (m["linked_id"],)).fetchone()
                info = f"TGAZ {m['linked_id']}: {r[0]} ({r[1]}), {r[2]}-{r[3]}, at {r[4]}, {r[5]}"
            iid = f"{typ}|{m['record_id']}|{m['text']}|{m['linked_id']}"
            it = rb.add_item(id=iid, heading=f"{typ} · {m['record_id']} · {m['gregorian']} · “{m['full_name']}”",
                             source=text[a:b], source_html=src)
            it.add_context("Linked to", info)
            it.add_context("How", f"{m['method']} ({m['confidence']}); {m['n_kept']} of {m['n_candidates']} candidates left after the filters")
            it.add_question(type="single", allow_none=False, notes=True,
                            prompt="Is this the right " + typ + "?") \
              .add_candidate(id="right", label="Right").add_candidate(id="wrong", label="Wrong") \
              .add_candidate(id="cannot-tell", label="Cannot tell")
            items.append({"id": iid, "method": method, "confidence": m["confidence"]})
    out = base / "review"; out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    rb.save_html(str(out / "entities_review.html"))
    (out / "items.json").write_text(json.dumps(items, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    print(len(items), "cards ->", out / "entities_review.html")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "pilot")
